subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The event showed that progress should not erase older abilities.”?
options: A repair culture helps people see objects as systems, not trash waiting to happen.
In emergencies, low-tech methods can keep high-tech systems from failing completely.
Changing habits requires systems that make better choices possible, not just good intentions.
When people depend on them completely, a small failure can create a large silence.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The event showed that progress should not erase older abilities. In emergencies, low-tech methods can keep high-tech systems from failing completely.」，答案為「In emergencies, low-tech methods can keep high-tech systems from failing completely.」。
